title: The All in One Addons For WPBakery Page Builder (formerly Visual Composer) WordPress plugin through 1.2 does not…
description: The All in One Addons For WPBakery Page Builder WordPress plugin through version 1.2 contains a vulnerability where it does not validate a shortcode attribute before using it to build a file path. This flaw could allow users with contributor role or higher to include and execute arbitrary local PHP files on the server.
